items.b: It often takes around two months, and it varies a lot. Don't quit on day 22.

You need a smaller first step. Two minutes is enough to start.
Tracking is how you see progress you'd otherwise forget.

chart.title: One bad day is a dip, not a crash.
chart.body: Your line keeps climbing if you come back tomorrow.

items.b: Restart with the next small action, today. The calendar doesn't decide when you begin.
Ten push-ups become two. One page instead of a chapter. Win the day first.
Bring back the one that makes the others easier. Usually sleep or movement.
A bad week is a dip on a long line. You didn't lose the points you earned before.
Decide now what you'll do on a bad day. A plan beats willpower.
